name: konyklabs-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins for expensive-model sessions on a budget: the supervisor harness, and domain skills for Python test engineering, production readiness, end-to-end sign-off, and OpenTofu on AWS, and the host side of agent-box.

plugins.name: supervisor
plugins.description: Token guardrails for sessions on Fable-tier models: writes the task brief from a short interview, pins spawns to cheap workers, denies forks, requires a brief for expensive spawns, prices a per-session budget from the transcript, and holds workers to an evidence contract.

plugins.name: py-testing
plugins.description: Python test engineering skills — pytest project structure, Playwright API and browser tests, SQLAlchemy test fixtures — and the untangling workflow for large unmerged test suites.

plugins.name: prod-readiness
plugins.description: Production-readiness and security-scanning checks: a categorized deterministic scan, summarized external scanners, and an auditor agent, ordered by observed impact.

plugins.name: signoff
plugins.description: Reconciles an application's end-to-end coverage against what it does: explore, mine, tile, fill, report, human-readable test cases.

plugins.name: terrain
plugins.description: OpenTofu on AWS, authored and reviewed the way the Python work is: a deterministic preflight (fmt, validate, the linters on PATH reduced to counts, structural checks for the Fargate and Lambda traps no linter catches, a plan summary that fails closed on destroy), a Terraform review lens with an Opus reviewer agent, and docs-first authoring references for ECS Fargate, Lambda, IAM, networking and state.

plugins.name: ts-testing
plugins.description: Vitest and TypeScript project skills, the py-testing shape for the TypeScript side: config that shares vite.config.ts, mocking and fake-timer rules, test.extend fixtures, typecheck mode, CI reporters and sharding; tsconfig for Node with nodenext, the TypeScript 6 and 7 default changes, strictness adoption, project references, type stripping; and a Sonnet test-implementer with both skills preloaded.

plugins.name: agentbox-channel
plugins.description: Orients a host session about the agent-box boxes on this machine: a card at every session start (the boxes, which mode the session is in, the four commands) and one line whenever a box has something open in its channel. Nothing from inside a box reaches the session through it. Needs the agentbox CLI on PATH (github.com/konyklabs/agent-box).
